Cluster: Education

Primary: Experi

As Human Beings, we seem to... primarily work with experiential, tangible knowledge objects. It is very difficult for us to reason in highly abstract spaces becausae of the massive sensory input distance (?) Numbers work this way for example. "325" does not seem particularly different from "3", "2" and "5", and neither does "3" seem different in scale than "5". Scale is a property of the language of numbers; Conveyance.
